scene.ko: 갑자기 일이 생겨 공연 환불을 물었다가 안 된다는 말을 듣고, 매진된 날 대신 대기자 명단과 다른 날 좌석으로 해결한다.

lines.en: Hi. I have two tickets for Moonlight Bakery this Friday, but something came up at work. Can I get a refund?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 이번 주 금요일 «달빛 빵집» 표가 두 장 있는데요, 회사에 일이 생겼어요. 환불받을 수 있을까요?
alt: Hi. I booked two tickets for Moonlight Bakery on Friday, but I can't go because of work. Is a refund possible?

lines.en: I'm sorry, but we can't offer refunds within 48 hours of the show. We can exchange them for another date, though.
lines.ko: 죄송하지만 공연 48시간 전부터는 환불이 안 됩니다. 대신 다른 날짜로 바꿔 드릴 수는 있어요.

lines.en: That's fine. Do you have anything on Saturday evening?
alt: Okay. Is there anything on Saturday evening?
That works. Are there seats on Saturday night?

lines.en: I'm afraid Saturday is completely sold out. Sunday afternoon has a few seats left, but they're in the balcony.
lines.ko: 죄송하지만 토요일은 완전히 매진이에요. 일요일 오후에 몇 자리 남았는데 발코니석이에요.

lines.en: Hmm, I was hoping to stay on the main floor. Is there a waiting list for Saturday?
lines.ko: 음, 1층에서 보고 싶었는데요. 토요일 대기자 명단이 있나요?
alt: I'd really like to keep main-floor seats. Can I get on a waiting list for Saturday?

lines.en: There is. People sometimes return tickets, but I can't promise anything.
lines.ko: 있어요. 가끔 표를 반납하는 분들이 있지만 장담은 못 드려요.

lines.en: I understand. Could you put me on the list and hold the Sunday seats just in case?
lines.ko: 알겠어요. 명단에 올려 주시고, 혹시 모르니 일요일 자리도 잡아 주실 수 있나요?
alt: I see. Can you add me to the list and keep the Sunday seats for me just in case?

lines.en: I can hold the Sunday seats until 5 p.m. tomorrow. And since they're cheaper, you'd get 20 dollars back.
lines.ko: 일요일 자리는 내일 오후 5시까지 잡아 둘 수 있어요. 그리고 더 싼 자리라서 20달러를 돌려받으실 거예요.

lines.en: Oh, that's a nice bonus. So if nothing opens up on Saturday, I'll just take the Sunday seats.
lines.ko: 아, 그건 좋은 덤이네요. 그러니까 토요일에 자리가 안 나면 그냥 일요일 자리로 할게요.
alt: That's a nice surprise. If Saturday doesn't open up, I'll go with Sunday.

lines.en: Perfect. I'll call you if a Saturday seat becomes available.
